name: Andromeda I
tagline: A faint Andromeda dwarf spheroidal — one of the diffuse satellites populating M31's outer halo.
history: Andromeda I is one of the faint dwarf spheroidals orbiting the Andromeda galaxy — so diffuse it was identified only through photographic survey work as a subtle excess of faint stars above the sky background. Its stars are mostly old and metal-poor, the typical product of a satellite that lost its gas early to ram pressure inside a giant host's halo. It belongs to the swarm of M31 companions now being counted and mapped by the Pan-Andromeda survey.
